source: Brandbook Kunumi Final (2025), plus the product-layer references named per rule
notes: Values, severities and authority strings live here. The mechanism that finds them lives in kunumi_design/checks/. A rule must never be implemented as a branch on its own id.
Rules whose values are already structured in tokens.json are derived in rules.py and carry no params here.
Scope is how documented tensions stay legible without muting the linter. Prefer demote over relax: demoting keeps the observation and drops only the alarm.
Web only. Print rules (MDC margins, non-ISO mm formats, CMYK/Pantone, the 10mm minimum) are deliberately absent and must not be added here.

web.new.label: New web, app or UI work under the 2025 brandbook

web.deck-derived.label: Web replica of a source slide deck
web.deck-derived.why: template-design-system.md: editing an existing deck preserves the inherited Figtree type, and slide-index.json template.sourceFonts lists Arial. The decks predate the 2025 brandbook.

web.chart.label: Data visualisation
web.chart.why: tokens.json color.chart.role: the palette was developed exclusively for data representation, so inside a chart it is the correct choice rather than a misuse.

web.instituto.label: Instituto Kunumi work using the signature gradient
web.instituto.why: tokens.json color.prohibition.institutoGradientException and color.instituto.blackException: #000000 is a sanctioned terminus of the Instituto gradient.

web.profile-photo.label: Channel profile portrait using the approved exact combinations
web.profile-photo.why: profile-photo-system.md prints twelve exact background/shirt/mark triplets that legitimately use #000000 and #FFFFFF. They are explicitly carved out of the prohibition and explicitly not transferable to any other artifact.

web.ksequence.label: Work derived from the extracted Ksequence visual reference
web.ksequence.why: visual-patterns.md is labelled 'Extracted visual reference; not a replacement for approved brand foundations' and carries its own non-brandbook palette.

exempt.label: Not a brand artifact - viewer chrome, scaffolding, test harness
exempt.why: Explicitly marked as outside the brand surface with data-kunumi-exempt.

rules.message: Pure black is not a Kunumi color; Chumbo replaces it.
rules.fix: Use --kunumi-chumbo (#1C2127). Black is permitted only as the Instituto gradient terminus, via --kunumi-instituto-black.

rules.message: Pure white is not a Kunumi color; Gelo replaces it.
rules.fix: Use --kunumi-gelo (#F0F0F0). White is permitted only as an elevated card surface on Gelo, via --kunumi-surface-raised.

rules.message: The chart palette was developed exclusively for data and must not become a UI accent or a background.
rules.fix: Use --kunumi-accent for emphasis, or --kunumi-ground / --kunumi-ink for surfaces. If this really is a chart, declare the web.chart scope.

rules.message: This hex belongs to the superseded chart palette, retained only to read older template charts.
rules.fix: Use the five current chart colors from color.chart.

rules.message: This color is not in any approved Kunumi palette.
rules.fix: Replace it with an approved token, or state why the artifact needs a value outside the system.

rules.message: An approved color is written as a literal where a semantic token exists.
rules.fix: Reference the semantic token so the artifact follows theme switching.

rules.message: The display face is titles only, and titles are always uppercase.
rules.fix: Add text-transform: uppercase, or set this text in Figtree if it is body copy.

rules.message: Display type is tracked +3%.
rules.fix: Use letter-spacing: var(--kunumi-track-display), which is 0.03em.

rules.message: A title past two rendered lines is set in the display face, where uppercase and +3% tracking stop helping.
rules.fix: Set this title in Figtree SemiBold, sentence case, tracking 0 - or cut it to two lines and keep the display face.

rules.message: Negative letter-spacing contradicts the brandbook, which tracks the display face positively.
rules.fix: Remove the negative tracking; use var(--kunumi-track-display) for titles and 0 for body.

rules.message: Arial is a body fallback only and must never appear in a display stack.
rules.fix: Use the declared display fallback order: Space Grotesk, then Figtree SemiBold uppercase.

rules.message: PP Neue Machina cannot be served to a browser, so naming it in a web display stack makes the render depend on which machine produced it.
rules.fix: Drop PP Neue Machina from the stack and let Space Grotesk lead. It is the brandbook's own stated alternate and is bundled under the SIL OFL.

rules.message: Display leading sits outside the brandbook range.
rules.fix: Bring the leading inside 110%-140%.

rules.message: Body leading sits outside the brandbook range.
rules.fix: Bring the leading inside 140%-175%; use var(--kunumi-leading-body).

rules.message: Only the 10px card radius and the 4px control radius are sanctioned.
rules.fix: Use var(--kunumi-radius-card) or var(--kunumi-radius-sm). Hairlines and edge alignment remain the dominant language.

rules.message: This spacing value is off the 4px product scale.
rules.fix: Use a --kunumi-space-* token. The brandbook's own 30px card padding and gap are exempt: use --kunumi-card-padding and --kunumi-card-gap.

rules.message: The mark must not carry effects or be recolored.
rules.fix: Swap in the correct positive or negative mark file instead of filtering the mark. kunumi_lookup.py sources --identity <id> lists the approved variants.

rules.message: The mark's proportions must not be altered.
rules.fix: Scale the mark uniformly, or set an explicit height and let the width follow.

rules.message: An artifact that animates must honor prefers-reduced-motion.
rules.fix: Add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block, or link kunumi-tokens.css, which already carries one.

rules.message: The file extension does not match the actual encoded format.
rules.fix: Re-export in the declared format. Prefer supplied SVG for vector work and transparent PNG for raster.

rules.message: This artifact was not produced by a render, so nothing ties it to the source it claims to depict.
rules.fix: Generate it: kunumi_critic.py render <html> --out-dir <this directory>. Never commit a screenshot as an artifact.

rules.message: This render is older than the source it depicts, so it no longer shows what ships.
rules.fix: Re-render the artifact: kunumi_critic.py render <html> --canvas <w>x<h>.

rules.message: The lockup is rendered below its 28px digital minimum.
rules.fix: Raise the lockup to at least 28px of rendered height, or remove the mark from this surface.
